title: Public Alert No. 35/2025 – Substandard batches of Annmox (Amoxicillin suspensions 125mg/5ml) and Jawamox (Amoxicillin suspension 125mg/5ml) manufactured by Jawa International Ltd due to low Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) content

products.manufacturer: Jawa International Limited, Plot 6, Abimbola Way, Isolo Industrial Estate, Lagos.
Jawa International Limited, Plot 6, Abimbola Way, Isolo Industrial Estate, Lagos.

summary: NAFDAC is recalling and mopping up substandard batches of Annmox (batch 360M) and Jawamox (batches 4290M, 4231M) amoxicillin 125mg/5ml suspensions by Jawa International Ltd, which failed lab tests for low active ingredient content.
